entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: Strongest elvish tribe on Lorwyn, once the Gilt-Leaf Empire, ruled from Lys Alana by a king and queen.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: Capital of the Gilt-Leaf, where the king and queen reign.

entities.name: Eyeblights
entities.description: Elves deemed ugly or disfigured, killed or turned into vinebred warriors.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Figure whose fall weakened the Gilt-Leaf's power.

events.summary: Gilt-Leaf elves proclaim those found ugly, disfigured or maimed eyeblights and kill them or transform them into vinebred warriors.
events.quote: proclaimed eyeblights and either killed or transformed into vinebred warriors

events.summary: The Gilt-Leaf's power is weakened after the fall of Oona and the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Before their power was weakened after the fall of Oona and the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: The center of their realm was the Gilt-Leaf Wood
